requirement:
Create a small Go module using only the standard library. Use exactly this go.mod:
module example.com/task

go 1.22

Put the implementation in `lib/palindrome.go` (package `lib`) and your own tests in `lib/palindrome_test.go` (package `lib`, `go test`). No third-party modules.

SPEC: Implement `func IsPalindrome(s string) bool`. Report whether s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and ignoring every character that is not an ASCII letter or digit. The empty string is a palindrome.
acceptance_criteria: func IsPalindrome(s string) bool: Report whether s reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case and ignoring every character that is not an ASCII letter or digit. The empty string is a palindrome.
